description: The revised Lead and Copper Rule requires every US public water system to prepare and maintain an inventory of the materials of its service lines by 16 October 2024, and the EPA page collects the implementation material for it. The main items are the Guidance for Developing and Maintaining a Service Line Inventory (document 816-B-22-001, 4 August 2022), an Excel inventory template that systems, states and Tribes can use or adapt, case studies on building and communicating inventories, and an implementation fact sheet on the initial inventory, notification of persons served by known or potential lead lines, and Tier 1 public notice of an action level exceedance. The guidance highlights prioritising disadvantaged communities and places where children live and play. Coverage: national rules, with each system's own inventory published locally, not here. Access: free documents and a spreadsheet template; the licence is not stated beyond federal government data. Caveats: this is a guidance and template page, not a national inventory, and the rule text has been revised again through the Lead and Copper Improvements proposal. It informs the field structure and data quality of pipe-material inventories used in lead exposure, renewal-priority and replacement-cost simulations, and relates to the national needs survey and SDWIS records.
